entries.title: Job 3:1
segments: ¶After this Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his [birth].

entries.title: Job 3:2
segments: And Job spoke, and said:

entries.title: Job 3:3
segments: "May the day perish on which I was born, And the night [in which] it was said, 'A male child is conceived.'

entries.title: Job 3:4
segments: May that day be darkness; May God above not seek it, Nor the light shine upon it.

entries.title: Job 3:5
segments: May darkness and the shadow of death claim it; May a cloud settle on it; May the blackness of the day terrify it.

entries.title: Job 3:6
segments: [As for] that night, may darkness seize it; May it not rejoice among the days of the year, May it not come into the number of the months.

entries.title: Job 3:7
segments: Oh, may that night be barren! May no joyful shout come into it!

entries.title: Job 3:8
segments: May those curse it who curse the day, Those who are ready to arouse Leviathan.

entries.title: Job 3:9
segments: May the stars of its morning be dark; May it look for light, but [have] none, And not see the dawning of the day;

entries.title: Job 3:10
segments: Because it did not shut up the doors of my [mother's] womb, Nor hide sorrow from my eyes.

entries.title: Job 3:11
segments: ¶"Why did I not die at birth? [Why] did I [not] perish when I came from the womb?

entries.title: Job 3:12
segments: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breasts, that I should nurse?

entries.title: Job 3:13
segments: For now I would have lain still and been quiet, I would have been asleep; Then I would have been at rest

entries.title: Job 3:14
segments: With kings and counselors of the earth, Who built ruins for themselves,

entries.title: Job 3:15
segments: Or with princes who had gold, Who filled their houses [with] silver;

entries.title: Job 3:16
segments: Or [why] was I not hidden like a stillborn child, Like infants who never saw light?

entries.title: Job 3:17
segments: There the wicked cease [from] troubling, And there the weary are at rest.

entries.title: Job 3:18
segments: [There] the prisoners rest together; They do not hear the voice of the oppressor.

entries.title: Job 3:19
segments: The small and great are there, And the servant [is] free from his master.

entries.title: Job 3:20
segments: ¶"Why is light given to him who is in misery, And life to the bitter of soul,

entries.title: Job 3:21
segments: Who long for death, but it does not [come], And search for it more than hidden treasures;

entries.title: Job 3:22
segments: Who rejoice exceedingly, [And] are glad when they can find the grave?

entries.title: Job 3:23
segments: [Why is light given] to a man whose way is hidden, And whom God has hedged in?

entries.title: Job 3:24
segments: For my sighing comes before I eat, And my groanings pour out like water.

entries.title: Job 3:25
segments: For the thing I greatly feared has come upon me, And what I dreaded has happened to me.

entries.title: Job 3:26
segments: I am not at ease, nor am I quiet; I have no rest, for trouble comes."
